+
+-- Retain the fixture's exact unsupported boundary independently of prefix
+-- projection. A malformed legacy body must not become a header-stop oracle.
+private func lambda_hole_boundary_matches(text: String) -> Bool:
+	existing = parse_compiler_source(source_file(ROOT_PATH, ROOT_MODULE_NAME, text))
+	lexed = lex_module(module_id_at_row(0), text)
 
+	match new_parse_state(lexed):
+		Ok(entry):
+			(_, scan) = ScanStop.scan_module_declarations(entry)
+			match scan.stop:
+				ScanStop.StoppedAtUnreadDeclaration(unread):
+					existing.diagnostics.is_empty() and unread.stop.reason == LambdaInInterpolationHole
+				_:
+					False
+		Err(_):
+			False
+
+
 func test_function_header_projection_compares_rich_authored_and_forward_headers() -> Bool:
 	var correct: Bool = True
+
+	for text in [
+		FUNCTION_HEADER_SOURCE + unread_block("\t", "value"),
+		TRAIT_HEADER_SOURCE,
+		IMPLEMENTATION_HEADER_SOURCE,
+	]:
+		correct = lambda_hole_boundary_matches(text) and correct
 
 	-- Pair the forward declaration so the independent old module oracle accepts
 	-- it. A forward declaration is read in full, so the projection stops at the
